# DynoWeb
> AI-powered CRO tool that finds revenue-leaking pages in Shopify stores
> and hands developers the exact file, before/after diff, and projected lift.
> Native Shopify app. Sub-40 KB tracker. 100% SEO-safe.

## Core docs
- [Home](https://www.dynoweb.app/): product overview, hero, how it works, pricing, FAQ
- [Use cases](https://www.dynoweb.app/use-cases): friction, conversions, mobile UX, journeys, safer storefront changes
- [Help center](https://www.dynoweb.app/help): setup, configuration, and product documentation
- [Case studies](https://www.dynoweb.app/case-studies): merchant outcomes
- [Install on Shopify](https://apps.shopify.com/dynoweb): app listing in the Shopify App Store
